_doc: Ratchet allowances for the plugin-kernel migration guardrails.
A guardrail fails when the current violation count EXCEEDS its allowance.
Allowances may only be lowered, never raised. Target for every key is 0.
Numbers recorded at P0 (baseline-1.7.0) unless noted. See docs/migration/.
_legacyFeatureKeySurfaces_note: Files that hardcode a list of the legacy class feature keys. P4 removed the backend copy by deriving the names from the class row and moving the catalogue into the classroom plugin manifest. P5 removed the frontend copy the same way: src/lib/classFeatures.generated.ts is generated from plugins/classroom/plugin.json by `npm run class-features`, and G13 verifies it is up to date. Target reached - this must stay 0.
_adoptedTables_note: P3: plugins that own a table still carrying its legacy name (see PluginDataDeclaration.adopted). Grown by design across P4.3b as domains migrate: classroom 2, economy 3, dungeon 1, gacha 3, slg 2, battles 1, challenge 2, collaboration 5, marketplace 4, portal 3 = 26. Every entry is renamed to p_<slug>_ by P7 (target 0). Permanently-shared tables (currently `records`) are EXCLUDED and checked separately, as is the one shared-WRITE table (`redemption_tickets`) - see the SHARED_WRITE_TABLES set in plugin-manifest-conformance.test.ts. The ratchet's real guard is that this cannot grow except by migrating another domain, so every increment is enumerated here by hand.
_routeCollisions_note: METHOD+PATH pairs served by more than one controller file. Invisible to the surface snapshot because it compares sets, and only the first registration is reachable. Mid-migration this equals the declaration count of every plugin whose legacy module still exists: 33 here (collaboration 16, marketplace 16, pet 1). It returns to 1 - the known `plugins/pet` vs `api/modules/pet` collision, HANDOFF 8.3.1 - once those legacy modules are deleted.
